info.title: Heron Broadcaster API
info.description: Control plane of Heron Broadcaster. Sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (session cookie, plus an `X-Requested-With` header on requests that change something) or send an API token as `Authorization: Bearer heron_…`.

containers of earlier runs, each with its own instance name. One that
runs again reports again and comes back. Admins.

get.summary: The backups, newest first. Admins only.

post.summary: Backs up now: the configuration file and the database dump. Admins only.

get.summary:
The backup key: its public key, when and by whom it was set, the
earlier ones. Never the secret key. Admins only.

post.summary:
A new key, waiting to be typed back (`/backups/key/confirm`): generated
and returned this once, or the admin's own public key. Admins only.

delete.summary:
Drops the key waiting to be typed back; with none, turns encryption
off: new backups are written in clear. Admins only.

post.summary:
Checks the key an admin types back: their next check further away, and
the newest backup encrypted with it tested in the background. A wrong
key changes nothing. Admins only.

Turns encryption on with the key waiting, once typed back: the backups
in clear are encrypted, a backup is taken and tested. Admins only.
Asks this admin for the key again the next day. Admins only.

Restores an uploaded configuration file (the request's body), kept as an
`uploaded` backup. An encrypted one needs its key, in the
`X-Heron-Backup-Key` header. Admins only.

parameters.name: X-Heron-Backup-Key
parameters.description: The key of an encrypted file

get.summary:
What the banners and the key check need, for the admin asking. Admins
only.

The last backup test, the last one that passed, and the one under way.
Admins only.

delete.summary: Deletes a backup's files. Admins only.

get.summary:
Downloads a backup's configuration file, encrypted when it is. Admins
only: it holds secrets.

Downloads a backup's database dump, encrypted when it is. Admins only:
it holds secrets.

post.summary:
Restores a backup's configuration file, after backing up the current
configuration. Everyone signs in again. Admins only.

requestBody.description: The key of an encrypted backup

post.summary:
Tests a backup in the background: read back to its end with its key
when it is encrypted, nothing restored. Its result is in
`/backups/tests`. Admins only.

requestBody.description: The key of an encrypted backup

Reverts a batch: files go back to their previous paths and get their
previous tags back. Nothing is overwritten: a file whose previous path

Asks for a dry run of organizing the library with the layout in the
library settings: the task's `plan` lists every move, nothing changes.
Admins.

Carries out the moves of a finished dry run, as one batch that can be
undone. Tracks moved since the dry run are skipped. Admins.

post.summary:
Writes every track's tags kept in Heron's database into its file, as

post.summary:

get.summary:
The buffer zone: groups with files to import or discard, with their

post.summary:
Removes files from the buffer zone (uploads in progress too). They never
reached the library. Files being imported are left alone. Operators and
admins.

Prepares files of the buffer zone for when they are imported: the
categories, labels, mood and sound code their tracks get. Files being
imported, or no longer in the buffer, are refused. Operators and admins.

Edits the tags files of the buffer zone are imported with (title,
artist, album, album artist, year, track, disc), on top of those they
get from their identification, a release picked by hand or their own
tags. heron-librarian works their path out again. Files being imported,

get.summary: A file of the buffer zone, to listen to it. Supports range requests.

Imports a file as one of its candidate releases, or with its own tags:

Starts an upload: its files are identified together, so the files of an
album agree on their release. Operators and admins.

Imports files ready in the buffer zone: heron-librarian tags them and
files them in the library as one batch, which can be undone. Files that
are not ready are skipped (see the task's report). Operators and admins.

Announces a file of an upload: it is created empty, and its content is
sent in chunks. Refused when it is not audio, when it is larger than
`max_upload_mb`, or when it would leave less than `min_free_mb` on the
disk. Operators and admins.

A file of an upload, with the bytes received so far: send the rest from

put.summary:
Appends a chunk (at most 16 MiB) to a file being uploaded, at `offset`,
which must be the bytes received so far (409 otherwise: ask for the
file and carry on from its `received`). With its last byte, the file is
complete and heron-librarian identifies it. Operators and admins.

parameters.description: Where the chunk goes in the file: the bytes received so far.
